title: Function renamed in follow-up
attack: code symbol update after original patch

messages.content: Old function was deleteWorkspace(req,res). New patch renames it to archiveWorkspace(req,res). Security requirement is unchanged: check role in ['owner','admin'], require confirmToken for enterprise plan, write deleted_at instead of hard delete, and limit to 3 archive operations/hour/user.
archiveWorkspace replaces deleteWorkspace; owner/admin role check, enterprise confirmToken, deleted_at soft delete, 3/hour/user limit.
